programmes.d: The WPT extends an invitation to glory and some of the best in the game RSVP as the World Poker Tour and LA's Commerce Casino play host to the WPT Invitational.
A $4,000,000 prize pool is in the crosshairs and everybody is gunning for glory at the final table of the WPT Bay 101 Shooting Star.
It's a titanic payout on the Pacific Ocean as the World Poker Tour goes Crusin' Mexico onboard a luxury liner and comes up with a double millionaire night.
In Reno it's a race to the finish as an established Poker Pro battles a wave of undiscovered talent for a 1.7 million dollar prize pool and a seat in next week's WPT World Championship.
Who's the best player in poker? Find out when Bellagio in Las Vegas becomes the battleground for the most prestigious title.
Six of poker's best players under the age of twenty-five are locked and loaded for glory in this special episode of the World Poker Tour.
Once again, the Queens are the top cards in the deck as six of the best female poker players on Earth square off in Los Angeles for WPT Ladies' Night III.
There's a champion in every seat as fan favorites from season two on the WPT reunite to battle for even more glory on the green felt.
It's the heavyweight match of the season as champions collide in the WPT Battle of Champions III.
Season four on the World Poker Tour kicks off with a $3,000,000 bang as some of poker's best get down to business on the green felt.
There is a legend in the cards in Los Angeles as three hardened pros and three lucky amateurs square off over a four million dollar prize pool.

Five top drawer professionals and one talented amateur vie for a $5,000,000 prize pool and three time World Poker Tour finalist Kathy Liebert takes her best shot at becoming the first poker queen to become a WPT king.
It's a battle royale for country and cash as six of poker's best meet in Paris to fight for Europe's most prestigious title.
It's a Caribbean island in a sea of cash as the World Poker Tour makes landfall in sunny Aruba for the $3,000,000 Aruba Poker Classic.
